QUOTE: `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` is commented out (`include/mbedtls/mbedtls_config.h:3787`). `MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD` and `MBEDTLS_THREADING_ALT` are also commented out (lines 2185, 2196).
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that the shipped mbedtls_config.h leaves the threading macros undefined (commented out). That includes MBEDTLS_THREADING_C and both PTHREAD and ALT, so the default build defines none of them.
